record.title: Classification of simple weak $SL(n)$-invariant valuations
record.statement: **Conjecture.** If $\Phi:\mathcal K_0^n\to\mathbb R$ is an $SL(n)$-invariant, simple weak valuation of first Baire class, homogeneous of degree $q$, and vanishes on polytopes, then $\Phi(K)=c\,\Omega_p(K)$ for every $K\in\mathcal K_0^n$, where $p=\frac{n(n-q)}{n+q}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/04](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4199), page 9. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Nonexistence of uniformly $L^2$-bounded cochain projections in the $p$-version
record.statement: The conjecture is that $p$-uniformly $L^2$-bounded cochain projections onto suitable discrete subcomplexes of the de Rham complex do not exist, in general.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/10](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4211), page 31. Canonicalized from 7 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Unfriendly partition for countable graphs without a subdivision of an infinite clique
record.statement: Let $G=(V,E)$ be a countable graph. If $G$ contains no subdivision of the complete countable graph as a subgraph, then there exists a partition $p:V\to\{1,2\}$ such that, for every vertex $v\in V$, $|N_p^u(v)|\ge |N_p^f(v)|$, where $N_p^u(v)$ and $N_p^f(v)$ are respectively the neighbors of $v$ in the other and in the same partition class.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4212), page 6. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Seymour–Goldberg conjecture for multigraph edge-colouring
record.statement:
For every multigraph $G$, the chromatic index satisfies
$$
\chi'(G)\le \max\{\lceil\rho(G)\rceil,\,\Delta(G)+1\},
$$
where
$$
\rho(G):=\max\left\{\frac{2|E[S]|}{|S|-1}: S\subseteq V(G),\ |S|\ge 3\text{ and odd}\right\}.
$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4212), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Unique Linkage Theorem
record.statement: For all $k \ge 1$, there exists a value $w(k)$ such that the following holds. Let $P$ be a linkage of order $k$ in a graph $G$ with $V(G)=V(P)$. If there does not exist a linkage $P'$ in $G$ which is equivalent to $P$ and uses strictly fewer vertices than $P$, then the tree-width of $G$ is at most $w(k)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4212), page 54. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Nontrivial idempotents in the reduced free orthogonal quantum-group C*-algebra
record.statement: For every integer $n>2$, the reduced C*-algebra $A_o(n)_{\mathrm{red}}$ does not contain nontrivial idempotents.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/13](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4214), page 51. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Perturbations of separable nuclear C*-algebras
record.statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be C*-algebras acting on a separable Hilbert space $H$. If $A$ is separable and nuclear and their Kadison–Kastler distance satisfies $\lVert A-B\rVert<10^{-11}$, then there exists a unitary $u\in(A\cup B)''$ such that $uAu^*=B$. Here $\lVert A-B\rVert$ is the Hausdorff distance between the unit balls of $A$ and $B$, viewed as subsets of the unit ball of the ambient C*-algebra.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/13](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4214), page 59. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Haglund’s Schur-positivity conjecture for specialized integral Macdonald polynomials
record.statement:
For every partition \(\lambda\), every partition \(\mu\), and \(k\in\mathbb N\), the Schur coefficient
\[
\left[s_\mu\right]\frac{J_\lambda(X;q,q^k)}{(1-q)^{|\lambda|}}
\]
belongs to \(\mathbb N[q]\). Equivalently, \(J_\lambda(X;q,q^k)/(1-q)^{|\lambda|}\) is Schur-positive over \(\mathbb N[q]\).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/15](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4216), page 15. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: A tableau formula for products of symmetric Macdonald polynomials

record.title: Farrell–Jones Conjecture for torsionfree groups and regular rings
record.statement:
Let $G$ be torsionfree and let $R$ be regular. Then the assembly maps for algebraic $K$- and $L$-theory
\[
H_n(BG;\mathbf{K}_R)\longrightarrow K_n(RG),\qquad
H_n\bigl(BG;\mathbf{L}_R^{\langle-\infty\rangle}\bigr)\longrightarrow L_n^{\langle-\infty\rangle}(RG)
\]
are bijective for all $n\in\mathbb{Z}$.

record.title: Conjecture 1 on cohomological dimension of elementary amenable groups
record.statement:
Fix a commutative ring $k$. For a group $G$, define
\[
\operatorname{cd}_k(G):=\sup\{n\mid H^n(G,M)\neq 0\text{ for some }kG\text{-module }M\}.
\]
Then, for every elementary amenable group $G$, $G$ has finite cohomological dimension over $k$ if and only if:

1. $G$ has finite Hirsch length;
2. $|G|<\aleph_\omega$; and
3. the orders of all finite subgroups of $G$ are invertible in $k$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4333), page 33. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Nonzero Hankel determinants at every order and position
record.statement:
Let $a=(a_i)_{i\\ge 0}$ be an infinite sequence of integers. The Hankel determinant of order $n$ beginning at position $k$ is
\[
\det\bigl(a_{k+i+j}\bigr)_{0\le i,j<n}.
\]
Is there an infinite sequence $a$ over a finite subset of $\mathbb{Z}$ such that these Hankel determinants are nonzero for every order $n\ge 1$ and every position $k\ge 0$?

record.title: Conjecture 48: avoidance of additive cubes

record.title: Equal-length monochromatic block factors in a non-periodic word (Question 53)
record.statement: Let $A$ be a non-empty finite alphabet and let $W\in A^{\mathbb N}$ be a non-periodic infinite word. record.title: Pure codimension of the odd triple-point theta locus
record.statement:

\operatorname{diam}(\Gamma(L,S))\le C(\log |L|)^c.
\]

record.title: Local well-posedness for the KdV equation in generalized Sobolev spaces
record.statement:
The Cauchy problem for the KdV equation is locally well-posed in \(\widehat H_s^r(\mathbb R)\) if \(1<r<2\) and
\[
s>\max\left(-\frac12-\frac{1}{2r'},\,-\frac14-\frac{11}{8r'}\right),
\]
where \(\frac1r+\frac1{r'}=1\) and \(\|f\|_{\widehat H_s^r}:=\|\langle\xi\rangle^s\widehat f\|_{L^{r'}_\xi}\).

record.title: Conjectured bounds for higher symmetrized topological complexity
record.statement:

\]

record.title: The Rε-Conjecture

record.title: The Harmonic Analysis Conjecture
record.statement:
For every measurable set $E\subseteq[0,1]$ and every $\varepsilon>0$, there exists a finite partition $(A_j)_{j=1}^r$ of $\mathbb{Z}$ such that, for every $j=1,2,\ldots,r$ and every $f\in S(A_j)$,
\[
(1-\varepsilon)|E|\,\|f\|^2\le \|P_Ef\|^2\le (1+\varepsilon)|E|\,\|f\|^2.
\]
Here $S(A)=\operatorname{span}\{e^{2\pi i n t}:n\in A\}\subseteq L^2[0,1]$ and $P_Ef=\chi_E f$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/49](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4531), page 26. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Frame bounds of Gaussian Gabor frames near critical density
record.statement:

$$c(1-a^2)\le A(a)\le C(1-a^2),\qquad c<B(a)<C.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/49](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4531), page 33. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: A resolvent bound with the factor $(|z|-1)^{\alpha}$
record.statement:
Let $T$ be an operator on a finite-dimensional Banach space satisfying $P(T)=\sup_{k\ge 0}\|T^k\|<\infty$, let $R(z,T)=(zI-T)^{-1}$, and let $0<\alpha<1$. Is there a constant $C_\alpha>0$ such that

$$
\|R(z,T)\|\le \frac{C_\alpha P(T)}{(|z|-1)^\alpha}

record.title: Inverting functions in the Drury–Arveson space
record.statement: For an integer $d\ge 1$, let $H^2_d$ be the Drury–Arveson space on the unit ball $B_d\subset\mathbb{C}^d$. If $f\in H^2_d$ and $|f(z)|\ge 1$ for every $z\in B_d$, must $1/f\in H^2_d$?
